description: Single registry of every action id and value binding that screens may reference. The validator enforces (a) screens only reference entries listed here, (b) each platform's bindings.json implements every action/binding its merged tree uses. To add a new action or binding, add it here first.

settings.toggle.description: Open or close the Settings panel.

tasks.add.description: Append a new task using ui.draftTitle.

cloud.confirmEnable.description: From the sheet: persist URL, flip cloudSyncEnabled on, fire CLOUD_SYNC_CHANGED.

cloud.disable.description: Turn cloud sync off; stop the engine.

cloud.saveUrl.description: Persist the current backendURL value to Prefs.

cloud.ping.description: Ping the configured backend and update ping state.

account.forget.description: Wipe the mnemonic from local storage; turn cloud sync off.

account.scanQR.description: (web only) Open the camera and scan a QR to import an account.

debug.copyDiagnostics.description: (macOS debug) Copy diagnostic info to the clipboard.

debug.resetState.description: (macOS debug) Reset all local app state (DB, prefs, keychain).

debug.forceCrash.description: (macOS debug) Deliberately crash, for testing crash reporting.

prefs.backendURL.description: Backend URL the sync engine talks to.

prefs.syncIntervalAmount.description: Numeric part of the sync interval.

prefs.showInDock.description: (macOS only) Show the app icon in Dock.

prefs.logLevel.description: (macOS debug only) Verbosity of in-process logging.

ui.draftTitle.description: In-progress text in the Add-task field.

ui.showMnemonic.description: Disclosure state of the mnemonic block.

ui.showQR.description: Disclosure state of the QR-display block.

ui.showQRScan.description: (web only) Disclosure state of the QR-scan block.

ui.showEnableSheet.description: Whether the Enable-Cloud-Sync sheet is open.

ui.enableUrl.description: URL field inside the Enable-Cloud-Sync sheet.

account.qrPng.description: PNG bytes of the QR encoding the mnemonic.

device.id.description: Per-device UUID used by the sync engine.
